BUBT Research Graduate School

To be a leading graduate school recognized for academic excellence, impactful research, and contributions to society.

Room: 205, Floor: 1, Building: 1, BUBT Main Campus

About the Office

The BUBT Research Graduate School is a newly established graduate-level academic unit at BUBT (launched in 2025). It’s dedicated to advanced education, research excellence, and producing professionals capable of tackling complex real-world challenges through scholarship and innovation.

Global Outlook
